sources.title: Gte Multilingual Reranker Base: Specs, Hardware & Live AI Battle ...
sources.snippet: Gte Multilingual Reranker Base is a high-dimensional text embedding and semantic retrieval model developed by Onnx Community. Tailored for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector database indexing, semantic similarity matching, and cross-lingual passage re-ranking.
